Name: Operating checking
Notes: Insurance EFTs and card deposits land here

Name: Contract clinician pay owed
Notes: Optional. Splits worked out at month end but paid in the next month

Name: Payroll liabilities
Notes: Withholdings and employer taxes, if anyone is on payroll

Name: Business credit card
Notes: The payment from checking is a transfer, not an expense

Name: Owner draws
Notes: Owner pay taken as a draw. Not an expense

Name: Insurance revenue
Notes: EFT payments from insurance payers. Add one account per panel if you want revenue by payer

Name: Self-pay revenue
Notes: Card, cash and HSA card payments from clients, including out-of-network clients who file a superbill

Name: Contract clinician payments
Notes: Each clinician's share of what they collected. Skip in a solo practice

Name: Wages
Notes: Only for staff or clinicians on payroll

Name: Payroll taxes
Notes: Employer share from the payroll report

Name: Merchant fees
Notes: Card processor fees on self-pay payments
